title: Newly Established Snack Manufacturing Company for Sale in Surat, India
tagline: Newly established vacuum-fried snacks brand operating in the better-for-you and premium snacking segment which can generate revenue upto INR 3-6 Cr/Annum depending on the product chosen for selling. - At present the business manufactures vacuum-fried potato snacks under its own brand and targets health-conscious and premium snacking consumers. - Products are currently sold through 100+ modern trade stores across Gujarat and through online marketplaces including Amazon and JioMart which happened In just 1 month as a pilot project to check market acceptance of vacuum-fried snacks. - The sale includes a ready-to-use manufacturing facility with fully installed automatic production machinery and an installed capacity of approximately 5-8 metric tons per year. - The business has established production SOPs and a team of 7 trained production staff. - The transaction includes the brand IP, website, packaging and design assets, production processes, and existing distribution presence. - The promoters have built the manufacturing facility, production processes, brand, and initial distribution network from scratch and have experience in setting up manufacturing-led brands. - The business holds an FSSAI license.
